title: [WIP] Fix object grid application error
body:
## Fix Object Grid Documentation Page Error ✅

**Problem:** The object grid documentation page was throwing a client-side exception: "Maximum update depth exceeded" causing an infinite re-render loop.

**Root Causes Identified:**
1. **SelectTrigger missing ref forwarding**: The `SelectTrigger` component in `packages/components/src/ui/select.tsx` wasn't using `React.forwardRef`, causing React ref callback issues and infinite re-render loops
2. **Renderer wrappers passing null dataSource**: The view component renderers in `packages/views/src/index.tsx` were passing `null` as dataSource without validation

**Changes Made:**
- [x] Investigate the issue and identify root cause
- [x] Fix `SelectTrigger` component to use `React.forwardRef` pattern (consistent with other UI components like Button)
- [x] Improve ObjectGrid, ObjectForm, and ObjectView renderer wrappers to validate inline data before rendering
- [x] Add helpful error messages for cases without staticData or dataSource
- [x] Test the fix by restarting dev server with cleared cache
- [x] Verify the page loads without errors
- [x] Run code review (✅ No issues found)
- [x] Run security checks (✅ No vulnerabilities found)
- [x] Verify other pages still work correctly

**Files Changed:**
1. `packages/components/src/ui/select.tsx` - Added `React.forwardRef` to `SelectTrigger` component
2. `packages/views/src/index.tsx` - Added validation for inline data in renderer wrappers

**Before (Error State):**
![Error Screenshot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/841b5781-e188-41bd-871a-d368c1ddaaaf)

**After (Fixed):**
![Working Screenshot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b17d529d-b623-45a7-b248-b1dfb0df5c74)

**Verification:**
- ✅ Object grid documentation page loads successfully
- ✅ All interactive demos render correctly
- ✅ No console errors
- ✅ Components page verified working
- ✅ Code review passed with no issues
- ✅ Security scan passed with no vulnerabilities

The object grid documentation page now loads successfully with all interactive demos working correctly!
